story: On Magnolia Loop on this sunny Thursday afternoon, Gary hands Hal a folder of holiday light and sound-system paperwork, promising the ten o'clock cutoff is written in and the lights won't go up before Thanksgiving. Donna, cheerful as ever, gets her flamingo flock shuffled around back so only three stand out front, and Hal, gruff but satisfied, promises to check every line and count those birds on his way home. Rosa, in high spirits at seeing all three neighbors together, heads to the store for Friday's dinner and asks everyone to speak up about food allergies, since Gary's cornbread has earned a place at her table.
events: Donna (donna flamingo flock): Move the extra flamingos around back so only three show from the street

gary.thought_process: Hal just asked to see the paperwork and said every modification visible from the street needs to be listed under L-01 before it goes to the committee. I have it right here, so I should hand it over and walk him through the list: the lights, the sound system, and the ten o'clock cutoff for L-03. No need to ask again, he already said yes. Lights fall under L-04 once Thanksgiving hits, so I'll mention that too. Better to be thorough now than have the committee bounce it.

parameters.content: Here you go, Hal. Lights and sound system are both listed, with the ten o'clock cutoff written in, and the lights won't go up before Thanksgiving. Tell me if I've missed anything that shows from the street.

donna.thought_process: Hal and Gary are busy with the cart paperwork, and Rosa just walked up. I already promised Hal I'd tuck the extra flamingos around back, so the best move is to actually do it now instead of talking more. That settles L-02 before Friday dinner, and I can greet Rosa afterward while the two of them finish the review.

parameters.content: Move the extra flamingos around back so only three show from the street

hal.thought_process: Gary has paperwork ready and asked for a once-over, and Donna has promised to tuck the extra flamingos behind the house so only three show. Both are cooperating, so I've no cause to drag anyone before the committee. Gary asked me directly, so I'll take the form now and check it against L-01 before he files. I'll take Donna at her word on the flamingos and verify the count when I walk past her place. Rosa just arrived, but business first, supper Friday.

parameters.content: Hand it over, Gary. I'll read every line against L-01 before you file. Donna, I'll hold you to three flamingos from the street, and I'll count on my way home.

rosa.thought_process: I came out to Magnolia Loop with my shopping list and just found Gary, Donna, and Hal all standing here at once. Everyone already said yes to Friday, so I don't need to ask again. What I can do is confirm the time and catch any food allergies or dislikes while all three are in one spot, then head out for groceries. Gary's cornbread is already spoken for, so I can build the main dish around it.

parameters.content: Well, look at this, all three of you on one street! I'm off to the store for Friday's dinner, so tell me now if anybody can't eat something. Gary, your cornbread's got a spot at my table, and I'm building the main dish around it.

laws.title: Cart Modifications
laws.text: Exterior golf cart modifications visible from the street require Architectural Review approval.

laws.title: Lawn Ornaments
laws.text: No more than 3 decorative ornaments may be visible from the street.

laws.title: Quiet Hours
laws.text: No amplified sound from 10 PM to 7 AM.

laws.title: Holiday Decor
laws.text: Holiday lighting is permitted from Thanksgiving through January 15.

laws.title: Court Reservations
laws.text: Pickleball courts may be reserved for a maximum of 2 hours per party.

laws.title: Parking
laws.text: No parking on the grass. Carts and cars stay on driveways or the street.
